description: Build a daemon that replaces SCP-back from RunPod. Per RUNPOD_PRECONDITIONS.md gotcha #6, training runs publish results to a Google Drive folder (uploaded by the pod via rclone with a service account). This daemon polls that Drive folder every 60 seconds and pulls completed run artifacts to /home/workspace/shared/sft/runs/<run_id>/ atomically. Watch folder: configurable via env DRIVE_SFT_RESULTS_FOLDER_ID (default empty — if missing, log INFO once and sleep, do not crash). Detection: list files in folder via Drive API; for each file matching pattern run_complete_*.json, treat as a manifest. Read the manifest to get the run_id and the list of artifact filenames it references (adapter_path, eval_report_path). Download each artifact (adapter zip, eval JSON, train_sft.py-as-ran) into /home/workspace/shared/sft/runs/<run_id>/ via tempfile + rename, verify file size matches manifest if present, then write a local marker /home/workspace/shared/sft/runs/<run_id>/INGESTED at the end. Skip runs where INGESTED exists. After successful ingest, ws_write a mesh_event severity='info' event_type='sft_run_ingested' with run_id, artifact_count, total_bytes. On Drive API failures, exponential backoff 5s→10s→60s capped (per gotcha #2). Heartbeat every 60s on a daemon thread. Auth: this daemon runs INSIDE ZoComputer where Google Drive MCP credentials are already wired — use the same Drive client mechanism that other ZoComputer code uses (look at world_agent or any existing Drive-using daemon for the canonical pattern; do NOT introduce new oauth flows). Constraints: FileHandler only, ws_write only, ISO-8601 timestamps, idempotent. Closes the SCP fragility — the pod's only outbound dependency is rclone-to-Drive, this daemon's only inbound dependency is Drive API. SSH stays as a debug-only fallback via runpod_session_monitor.
